description.value:
You learn to lace your shots with disruptive magic. Once per turn, when you hit with a ranged weapon attack, you can end any spells of 3rd level or lower on the target.

For each spell of 4th level or higher on the target, make an Ability Check using the ability score for your Arcane Shot save DC. The DC equals 10 + the caster's spellcasting ability modifier + the spell slot level of the target spell - 3. On a successful check, the spell ends.

You can use this features a number of times equal to half your Proficiency (rounded down) and you regain all expended uses on a Long Rest. You can also expend a use of your Arcane Shot to use this feature again (no action required).
